blocker.reason: The frozen preregistration simultaneously requires a globally clean worktree and forbids any resolve/stat/open/hash/read/create/rename/delete/probe of the v2.19 receipt and cache namespace. A worktree-wide Git status must enumerate the protected namespace's parent tree, so the two gates cannot both be proven. Leaf exclusion pathspecs filter matches after traversal and are not a zero-probe guarantee.
blocker.fail_closed: The formal run entry raises before result-path, audit, Git, catalog, visible-context, or C200 access.
